name: Vikunja v2
description: The open-source, self-hostable to-do app. Organize everything, on all platforms.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Vikunja database password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Mysql root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-vikunja-v2 application
services:
  vikunja-v2:
    image: vikunja/vikunja:2.7.1@sha256:f7dc8428d10aef17f3075886d3c1c022f566ec456f88985f02c137f4fc534576
    container_name: big-bear-vikunja-v2
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3456"
    volumes:
      # Map container path to host path for files
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/files:/app/vikunja/files
    environment:
      # Set the Vikunja frontend URL, replace <your public frontend url with slash> with the actual URL
      VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL: http://<your public frontend url with slash>/
      # Vikunja API environment variables
      VIKUNJA_DATABASE_HOST: vikunja-v2-db
      VIKUNJA_DATABASE_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_VIKUNJA_DATABASE_PASSWORD}
      VIKUNJA_DATABASE_TYPE: mysql
      VIKUNJA_DATABASE_USER: vikunja
      VIKUNJA_DATABASE_DATABASE: vikunja
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - vikunja-v2-db
    networks:
      - vikunja-v2-network
  vikunja-v2-db:
    image: mariadb:11@sha256:efb4959ef2c835cd735dbc388eb9ad6aab0c78dd64febcd51bc17481111890c4
    container_name: vikunja-v2-db
    command:
      - --character-set-server=utf8mb4
      - --collation-server=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    environment:
      # MariaDB environment variables
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_USER: vikunja
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_VIKUNJA_DATABASE_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: vikunja
    volumes:
      # Map container path to host path for MariaDB data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - vikunja-v2-network
networks:
  vikunja-v2-network:
    driver: bridge
